crossRefs.note: Surely there is no enchantment with Jacob; Neither is there any divination with Israel. Now it shall be said of Jacob…
Now Naaman, captain of the army of the king of Syria, was a great man with his master, and honorable, because by him…
“But who can endure the day of his coming? And who will stand when he appears? For he is like a refiner’s fire, and…
